title: ADC
text: Configure ADC to sample analog pins and output digital data, 1 output, {ADC Module} sets Select module to use; {ADC Resolution} selects 12 bit or 16 bit resolution 12-bit, {ADC mode}, {Sampling mode} selects sampling type, {SOC trigger number} sets the start of conversion, {SOCx acquisition window} sets the length of the acquisition period, {SOCx trigger source} sets the source that triggers the start of conversion, {ADCINT will trigger SOCx} uses ADC interrupt to trigger SOC, {Sample time} sets the interval at which block reads data, {Data type} selects the output data, {Post interrupt at EOC trigger} sets the post interrupts when ADC triggers, {Interrupt selection} sets the aDC interrupt selection, {ADC# continuous mode} sets the generate ADC interrupt and {Conversions channel} selects ADC channel to which this ADC conversion applies. Values come from the instance.

params.name: ADC Module
params.values: Select module to use A (default) | B | A and B

params.name: ADC Resolution
params.values: Select 12 bit or 16 bit resolution 12-bit (Single-ended input) (default) | 16-bit (Differential inputs)

params.name: ADC mode
params.values: Select ADC mode Single-ended input (default) | Differential inputs

params.name: SOC trigger number
params.values: Start of conversion number SOC0 (default) | SOC1 | SOC2 | …

params.name: SOCx trigger source
params.values: Source that triggers the start of conversion Software (default) | EVA | External pin

params.name: ADCINT will trigger SOCx
params.values: Use ADC interrupt to trigger SOC No ADCINT (default) | ADCINT1 | ADCINT2

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Interval at which block reads data 0.1 (default)

params.name: Data type
params.values: Select the output data type uint16 (default) | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | int32 | uint32

params.name: Post interrupt at EOC trigger
params.values: Post interrupts when ADC triggers Off (default) | on

params.name: Conversions channel
params.values: Select ADC channel to which this ADC conversion applies ADCINA0 (default) | ADCINA1 | ADCINA2 | …
